question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed gated Claws package and lifecycle contract as the product direction for the linked implementation tracks?
rationale: The patch is an RFC that creates new experimental CLI, manifest, ownership, and compatibility commitments; correctness review cannot determine whether that surface belongs in the product.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental contract
options.body: Accept the RFC as the scoped, gated product contract and use its stated ownership boundaries to guide the linked implementation work.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Keep the proposal open or close it without merge until a product owner chooses a smaller package scope or a different extension model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experimental contract
recommendation.body: Accept the RFC as the scoped, gated product contract and use its stated ownership boundaries to guide the linked implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: His existing review comments focus on the proposed name and MCP/connector model, the two product-boundary questions requiring resolution.
